extDescription.message: Transcribe WhatsApp Web and X voice notes on this device. No API keys.

errNoWebgpu.message: This Chrome has no WebGPU. Update Chrome (113+).

errWebgpuFallback.message: WebGPU isn't available, using the CPU (slower).

errDownload.message: Couldn't download the model. Check your connection or switch back to Small.

errNoAudio.message: Couldn't download this audio. Try again.

errMedia403.message: WhatsApp blocked the audio download (403). Try Chrome, or turn off Dia's content blocker.

errOom.message: Not enough memory. Try Small in the popup.

errOffscreen.message: Couldn't start the local engine. Reload the extension.

extReloadedX.message: The extension reloaded. Reload the X Messages tab.

extReloadedWa.message: The extension reloaded. Reload the WhatsApp Web tab.

extractFailX.message: Couldn't extract it automatically. Press play on the note in X, then tap Save audio again.

extractFailWa.message: Couldn't extract it automatically. Press play on the note in WhatsApp, then tap Save audio again.

textUnavailable.message: This Mac can't summarize or translate on device.

textBadRequest.message: The text is empty or too long.

textFailed.message: Couldn't process the text. Try again.

textOffline.message: The app didn't respond. Open it and try again.

appLoadingModel.message: The app is loading the model…

modelStillLoading.message: The model is still loading. Try again in a moment.

appNoResponse.message: The app didn't respond. Try again when it's ready.

gpuWarn.message: Your GPU looks integrated (Intel or similar). Medium and Turbo may run out of memory. Small is safer.

parakeetFast.message: ⚡ Transcribing with Parakeet v3 at ~100 ms (CoreML).

parakeetPreparing.message: The Parakeet v3 model is getting ready in the app.

whisperFallbackHint.message: Using Whisper in the browser. Open the TranscribeThem app for top speed.

modelSmallHint.message: Fast. ~250 MB. A word here and there may be off.

modelMediumHint.message: More accurate. ~1 GB. Slower than Small (the encoder is heavier).

modelTurboHint.message: The sharpest on-device. ~1.2 GB. Integrated GPUs (Intel) may run out of memory.

popupTag.message: WhatsApp and X messages. 100% on this device.

companionHintDefault.message: Transcribes with Parakeet when the macOS app is open.

siteHint.message: If you turn it off, the button disappears on that site.

optAutoHint.message: The language is detected for each note.

engineAutoHint.message: Uses this app. If it isn't there, transcribes in the browser.

engineCompanionHint.message: If the app doesn't respond, the note fails. The browser is not used.

engineBrowserHint.message: Always transcribes with Whisper in Chrome.

showTiming.message: Show the time for each note

highlightWords.message: Highlight the word as it plays

optAutoTranscribe.message: Transcribe each voice note as it appears

optAutoTranscribeHint.message: Only notes visible in the open chat, and only when the Mac app is transcribing.

cacheHint.message: The note stays transcribed when you reload the tab. Turning this off deletes the saved ones.

privacyBody.message: The voice note is decoded and transcribed on this machine. It is not sent to any transcription server. There are no API keys.

privacyDownload.message: The first time, the model weights download from Hugging Face (free) and stay in the browser cache. After that it works offline.

noButtonBody.message: For WhatsApp Web, make sure it's switched on above. Reload the extension, then the WhatsApp Web tab or the X Messages tab (x.com/i/chat or x.com/messages). The audio hook runs when the page starts.

xDebugWavesNoHost.message: waves are visible, but the classifier skips them

xDebugNoId.message: notes have no id; the button can't be built

xDebugNoButton.message: notes are here and the button was not created

xDebugHidden.message: the button exists and is hidden

xDebugShadow.message: the waves are inside a shadow DOM

xDebugNoWaves.message: there are messages and no audio waves

xDebugNoHook.message: the chat is visible and the audio hook did not start

xDebugCapped.message: no notes in this pass; the page is larger

xDebugPosition.message: button at $SAMPLE$; if you don't see it, it's the position

xDebugLine1.message: wa-t $VER$ · $FRAME$ · $PATH$ · rows $ROWS$ · waves $WAVES$$SHADOW$ · notes $NOTES$ · buttons $BUTTONS$ · hook $HOOK$
